declared_conventions.canonical_normalization: for a formal fixed-epsilon expansion whose zero-mean sector is preserved under variations, integral pi_phi delta phi=2*pi^2 Pibar delta phi_bar+epsilon^2 integral sqrt(gamma) xi delta vartheta; the latter integral is the coefficient at epsilon^2, not an unscaled canonical pair claim
declared_conventions.configuration: q_ab=a^2 exp(2 epsilon psi) gamma_ab, phi=phi_bar+epsilon vartheta, with a>0 spatially constant and external
declared_conventions.geometry: unit round S3 with Vol=2*pi^2, Delta Q_n=-n(n+2)Q_n, and Q_a Q_b=(2*pi^2)^(-1/2) sum_j Q_(a+b-2j)
declared_conventions.hard_cutoff: P_N retains Q_0 through Q_N after each local m_r is formed; tails are truncation diagnostics, not constraint-bracket residuals
declared_conventions.momentum: pi_phi=sqrt(gamma)(Pibar+epsilon xi); under the zero-mean condition p_phi=integral pi_phi=2*pi^2 Pibar
declared_conventions.v0_scalar_hamiltonian: H_perp_phi/sqrt(gamma)=(2a^3)^(-1)[exp(-3 epsilon psi)(Pibar+epsilon xi)^2+a^4 epsilon^2 exp(epsilon psi)|D vartheta|^2]
